channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: US tariffs are paid almost entirely by Americans, a German study finds
item.description: US tariffs under Donald Trump have been paid almost entirely by Americans, with foreign exporters paying for only 4%, a German study found.

item.title: They left pharma and fine dining to open a cozy bakery. Early mornings and 16-hour days are a small price to pay.
item.description: Au Hui Har and Liu Yi Wen fulfilled their dream of opening a cozy bakery in Singapore in July, after years of working in jobs that didn't suit them.

item.title: I flew to Bali for a surf camp. A conversation I had there about failure inspired me to launch a small business.
item.description: Gina Jaguttis shared how two solo trips to Bali led her to start her slow fashion business as a side hustle.

item.title: A Harvard MBA grad knew the immigrant dream wasn't for her. She moved back to China to start a search fund.
item.description: Sally Tian worried cultural differences would make it harder to build trust with sellers for a US search fund.

item.title: OpenAI could generate $25 billion in annual ad revenue by 2030, and that should worry Google, top tech analyst says
item.description: ChatGPT could provide advertisers with a valuable "high-intent" engaged audience, siphoning marketing budgets away from Google, Mahaney says

item.title: Russia's new Geran-5 turbojet drone looks like Iran's Karrar UAV and is souped up with American parts, Ukraine says
item.description: The Geran-5 features US parts such as digital signal processors and clock generators, along with a Chinese jet engine and $8,100 modem, GUR said.

item.title: Alexis Ohanian was asked if he misses anything about leading Reddit. He summed it up in 3 words.
item.description: Reddit's cofounder, Alexis Ohanian, said he does not miss being in leadership at the company.

item.title: OpenAI's finance chief just dropped some hints about how the company plans to make more money
item.description: OpenAI's chief financial officer floated "licensing models" as a revenue idea as the company faces massive compute costs.

item.title: Vinod Khosla is looking at this metric to gauge if we're in an AI bubble
item.description: "What Wall Street tends to do with it, I don't really care," Khosla said.

item.title: Italian fashion designer Valentino dies at 93. His legacy was his devotion to dressing women — many adored him.
item.description: "I loved how he always pestered me to 'at least wear a little mascara' when I came to dinner," Gwyneth Paltrow paid tribute to Valentino on Instagram.
